components.name: ComparisonTableBlock
components.doc: Preview: the comparison inside a capped height so the sticky header shows.

members.name: differencesOnly
members.doc: Hide rows where every visible column has the same value (controlled).

members.name: compareWith
members.doc: Competitor shown beside yours in the stacked phone layout (controlled).

members.name: cta
members.type: { label: string; href?: string; onClick?: () => void; doneLabel?: string }
members.doc: Call to action in your column.

members.name: stickyTop
members.doc: Offset for the sticky header, such as the height of a fixed site header. Defaults to 0.

members.name: maxHeight
members.doc: Caps the table height and scrolls it inside the block, with the header sticking to its top.

members.name: stackBelow
members.doc: Width below which the table stacks into a two column comparison. Defaults to 640.

types.name: ComparisonValue
types.doc: true is included, false is not, "partial" is limited, and a string prints as text (a limit, a price).
types.text: boolean | "partial" | string | { value: boolean | "partial" | string; note?: string }
